name: rftools.io board calculations
description: Reads the board's stackup and net classes and computes microstrip, stripline and differential impedance, the width or gap for a target impedance, the IPC-2152 width for a current, and via figures through the rftools.io API.

actions.name: rftools.io: impedance and widths
actions.description: Propose a layer model from the stackup, then compute impedance, target widths and gaps, current widths and via figures for the selected net classes.
